entities.summary: Jamaal Dane Magloire is a Canadian former professional basketball player who currently serves as basketball development consultant and community ambassador for the Toronto Raptors. He played 12 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Charlotte Hornets, New Orleans Hornets, Milwaukee Bucks, Portland Trail Blazers, New Jersey Nets, Dallas Mavericks, Miami Heat, and Toronto Raptors. The 6 ft 11 in (2.11 m), 265 lb center was selected out of the University of Kentucky by the Charlotte Hornets, with the 19th overall pick in the 2000 NBA draft, after withdrawing his name from the previous draft.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a 12-season NBA player and current basketball development consultant for the Toronto Raptors, Jamaal Magloire has had a significant impact on Canadian sports culture, particularly in the city of Toronto. His achievements on the court have also influenced youth basketball programs across North America.
